**Subject: Spare Plant Pot Swap**

Hi neighbors,

I’m organizing a casual exchange of spare plant pots for anyone who enjoys gardening. Bring along clean pots you no longer need, and swap them for something useful. If you don’t have any pots to share, please come anyway—you’re very welcome to browse, chat, and take one if you need it.

We’ll meet [date/time] at [location]. Hope to see you there!

Best,  
[Your Name]
